children: Indian Hotels Company (IHCL) has announced the opening of Ginger Goa, Arpora, strengthening its presence in Goa.

Deepika Rao, Executive Vice President – Select Service Business, IHCL, said, “The opening of Ginger Goa, Arpora strengthens IHCL’s presence in the state. Reflecting Ginger’s lean luxe philosophy, the hotel offers contemporary design, vibrant social spaces and the comfort and convenience that today’s travellers seek.”

The hotel has 77 rooms and includes Qmin, Ginger’s all-day diner, along with a pool café and bar. It also has banqueting and outdoor lawn spaces for corporate meetings, conferences, social events and celebrations. Located in North Goa, the property provides access to attractions including Fort Aguada, Miramar and Sinquerim beaches, and Anjuna Hillpoint.
The opening adds to IHCL’s portfolio in Goa and expands the Ginger brand’s presence in the state. The company continues to grow its select-service portfolio across key hospitality markets in India.
